ns2:section.sectionText: Connecting Work Experience and Your Education. This course connects a work/internship experience with your education in a directed manner that will help develop your personal, educational, and professional competencies. Students must secure an approved work/intern experience by the drop deadline for a second 8-week course. If section is full, please contact Gail Rooney (grooney@illinois.edu) and include full name and UIN. Students will be required to be online 6:00-8:30 pm on March 26, April 9 & 30, May 21, June 4 & 18, July 2, 16 & 30.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Liberal Arts & Sciences or Division of General Studies. Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
